sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body: Buildink may process account details, onboarding information, public marketplace content, support messages and technical activity required to operate the service.

sections.title: How information is used
sections.body: We use data to authenticate users, operate the marketplace, support verification workflows, respond to support requests and improve platform reliability.

sections.title: Using the platform responsibly
sections.body: Users are expected to provide accurate information, respect publication rules and avoid misuse of marketplace, communication or verification flows.

sections.title: Service availability
sections.body: Buildink works to keep the service available and secure, but features, workflows and content availability may evolve over time.

sections.title: Essential cookies
sections.body: Some cookies support language selection, session continuity, security protections and core public-site functionality.

sections.title: Preference choices
sections.body: Visitors can accept the recommended setup or review cookie-related choices through the cookie preference controls below.
